speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Fish. Threepence. You looked at a cold stage and you came home with an appetite, which is the arrangement I asked for.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Threepence. The stage was cold. The flag was up on the other bank. I did not cross.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is cold a kind of news, sir, or only a kind of weather?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is the news. We do not play. I am not bringing the morning's reading to this board a second time.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. One reading was the day's. This is supper. Sit, eat, and do not improve the fish into a moral.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not. The book at home still says the old year, and I am not saying a total over fish.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then I will clear three trenchers and not a story. Threepence is a number I can keep.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Keep it. Callers stop at the foot of the stair. A cold stage is not a caller if it stays in Shoreditch.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It stayed. I am going up when this is eaten. Enough fish for one night.
